style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the ant works his whole body every beat; coins, banknotes, worker ants and the mosquito fly through the foreground into him; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; the ant fills at least half the frame, never far off
character: the ant: glossy black ant, tired eyes, twitchy antennae; the fat bronze dung beetle boss; worker ants; ONE mosquito
props: ONE gold coin stack; ONE ball of crumpled banknotes; ONE bread loaf; ONE crumb; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit sandy anthill yard, grass blades, pebbles by the lens; the dung beetle boss with a banknote ball by a bread loaf close by

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, weary but brisk, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ya ta-SHU na se-BYE BOL'-she, chem VYE-shu SAM. a v i-TO-ge hva-TA-yet TOL'-ko na od-NU KROSH-ku
audio.pacing: 0.6-6.2 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: coin clinks, sand puffs, swooshes, buzz, crunch

timeline.a: the ant bucks up chin-deep in sand as coins clink onto his back, flicked by the beetle boss at frame edge; eyes bulging, sand flying across the lens
the ant trots hard on the spot, head jolting, antennae whipping across the lens, stack bouncing, jaws open on every word
timeline.c: extreme close-up on his face, push in, bouncing

timeline.a: the ant kicks a loose coin up onto his own stack and bucks the swaying stack on his back, jaws open on every word; worker ants roll coins through the foreground to the beetle
the ant humps and flings the whole stack up over his head, jaws open on every word, coins raining through the foreground onto the beetle's ball rolling in close
the ant stamps on the spot on all six legs, pumping both empty front claws, antennae thrashing, jaws open on every word
timeline.c: extreme close-up: jaws, eyes, pumping claws, push in

timeline.a: the ant scuttles sideways like a goalkeeper, front legs spread, as ONE crumb, snapped off the loaf by the beetle, flies to the ant
the ant dives, catches the crumb in both front legs, rolls once in the sand, springs up hugging it
timeline.c: sharp push in to extreme close-up

timeline.a: the ant spins a tiny happy jig on six legs, crumb hugged, while the beetle's huge banknote ball sweeps across the lens
ONE mosquito zips across the lens and bites off half the crumb; the ant leaps up snapping his jaws at it, lands hard, sand bursting
timeline.c: close, whip tilt up then down

timeline.a: the ant gulps the half crumb whole, then buckles chin-deep as ONE coin flicked by the beetle clinks onto his back; the ant bucks up, sand flying across the lens

must_appear: hook at 0.0: the ant bucking up under coins the beetle boss flicks onto his back; extreme close-ups at 0.6, 4.7, 6.8; crumb catch 6.8; mosquito bite 8.3
negative_prompt: held mic, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.2, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, price tags, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, mouth shut, duplicate props, floating objects, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a wide shot, a distant hero, a parked camera, static scenery, a motionless first or last second, top-down view, a cart, a rail
